name: last_final_sudoku_benchmark_all
description: A dataset of Sudoku puzzles and associated episodes intended to evaluate automated solvers and reinforcement learning agents on Sudoku-solving performance. It measures an agent's ability to complete puzzles correctly under varying starting configurations and difficulty levels. The benchmark reports per-puzzle solve rates and can be used to compare planning/solver approaches.
reputation: A niche dataset used in RL/solver research with limited but growing usage within the MultiRL community.
